scripts.text:

{0} Mercenary Guild.
What can I do for you?
scripts.translation:
[佣兵管理员]
欢迎来到{0}佣兵公会。
请问有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text: Hire Mercenary
scripts.translation: 雇佣佣兵

scripts.text: Mercenary Info
scripts.translation: 佣兵信息

scripts.text: Nothing
scripts.translation: 没什么

scripts.text: 10th Grade Mercenaries
scripts.translation: 10级佣兵

scripts.text:
[Mercenary Manager]
You want to hire a
{0} Mercenary?
Which Grade were you
interested in hiring?
scripts.translation:
[佣兵管理员]
您想雇佣一名{0}佣兵？
您想雇佣哪个等级的佣兵？

scripts.text:
[Mercenary Manager]
So you want to hire a {0}
Grade {1} Mercenary?
You need to have attained
Base Level {2} or higher, and
must pay the {3},000 zeny fee.
scripts.translation:
[佣兵管理员]
所以您想雇佣一名{0}等级的{1}级佣兵？
您需要达到基础等级{2}或更高，并支付{3},000 Zeny的费用。

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Mercenary Manager]
Oh, really? Well, now
might not be a good time
for you to consider hiring
a Mercenary, but please feel
free to come back if your
needs change. Thank you~
scripts.translation:
[佣兵管理员]
哦，是吗？现在可能不是您考虑雇佣佣兵的好时机，但如果您的需求有变，欢迎随时回来。谢谢~

scripts.text:
[Mercenary Manager]
Oh... Your Loyalty rating
with the {0} Mercenary
Guild isn't high enough to
hire this Mercenary. Please
come back after you earn
{1} or more Loyalty with us.
scripts.translation:
[佣兵管理员]
哦...您与{0}佣兵公会的忠诚度不够，无法雇佣这名佣兵。请在获得{1}或更高的忠诚度后再来。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary Manager]
I'm sorry, but your Base
Level isn't high enough
to hire this Mercenary.
Please come back to me
once you reach Base Level {0}.
scripts.translation:
[佣兵管理员]
很抱歉，您的基础等级不够，无法雇佣这名佣兵。请在达到基础等级{0}后再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary Manager]
I'm sorry, but you
don't have enough zeny
to hire this Mercenary.
The hiring fee is {0},000 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[佣兵管理员]
很抱歉，您的Zeny不足，无法雇佣这名佣兵。雇佣费用是{0},000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary Manager]
Great! Our Mercenaries
are sincere and devoted
to protecting their clients.
Summoned Mercenaries will
offer their support to you for
30 minutes. Take care now.
scripts.translation:
[佣兵管理员]
太好了！我们的佣兵对保护客户非常忠诚和尽职。召唤出的佣兵将为您提供30分钟的支持。请小心行事。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary Manager]
Mercenaries are soldiers
that will fight at your side
on the battlefield, but there
are a few terms and conditions
you must fulfill to hire them.
scripts.translation:
[佣兵管理员]
佣兵是会在战场上与您并肩作战的士兵，但雇佣他们需要满足一些条款和条件。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary Manager]
You must fulfill a level
requirement and pay a zeny
fee to hire a Mercenary.
Higher grade Mercenaries
will also require that you
build a Loyalty rating with us.
scripts.translation:
[佣兵管理员]
雇佣佣兵需要满足等级要求并支付Zeny费用。更高等级的佣兵还要求您与我们建立一定的忠诚度。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary Manager]
Mercenary contracts can't be
transferred to other people,
and we only allow a 5 Base Level difference between the Mercenary
and client so you can't hire one much stronger than you.
scripts.translation:
[佣兵管理员]
佣兵契约不能转让给其他人，且我们只允许佣兵与客户之间基础等级相差5级以内，因此您不能雇佣比您强太多的佣兵。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary Manager]
Well, you can figure out the
details when you actually form
a contract with one of our
Mercenaries, and receive
the Summon Scroll that will
call a Mercenary to your side.
scripts.translation:
[佣兵管理员]
嗯，当您实际与我们的佣兵签订契约时，您可以了解具体细节，并收到召唤卷轴，以将佣兵召唤到您身边。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary Manager]
You can't give this scroll
to anyone else, and the
Mercenary will only remain
with you for 30 minutes after
you summon him. Don't forget
about the time limit, okay?
scripts.translation:
[佣兵管理员]
您不能将此卷轴交给任何人，且召唤后佣兵只会陪伴您30分钟。别忘了时间限制，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Mercenary Manager]
No? You didn't need any
help? Well, feel free to
ask me if you have any
questions about Mercenaries.
scripts.translation:
[佣兵管理员]
不？您不需要任何帮助？如果您有关于佣兵的问题，随时可以问我。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary Manager]
10th Grade Mercenaries are
the best we have to offer,
and we use different criteria
for our clients to hire them.
There's no zeny fee, but you
must have 500 Loyalty.
scripts.translation:
[佣兵管理员]
10级佣兵是我们提供的最好的佣兵，我们使用不同的标准让客户雇佣他们。没有Zeny费用，但您需要500点忠诚度。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary Manager]
Once you make a contract
with a 10th Grade Mercenary,
your Loyalty rating will be
decreased by 400. In other
words, you pay 400 Loyalty
to hire a 10th Grade Mercenary.
scripts.translation:
[佣兵管理员]
一旦您与10级佣兵签订契约，您的忠诚度将减少400点。换句话说，您支付400点忠诚度来雇佣一名10级佣兵。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary Manager]
You must also be at
Base Level 90 or higher to
hire a 10th Grade Mercenary.
Are you still interested in
forming this contract?
scripts.translation:
[佣兵管理员]
您还必须达到基础等级90或更高才能雇佣10级佣兵。您仍然想签订这份契约吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Mercenary Manager]
I understand... It takes
hard work and sacrifice to
even reach the point where
you can hire a 10th Grade
Mercenary. Have you considered
hiring a lower grade Mercenary?
scripts.translation:
[佣兵管理员]
我理解... 能够雇佣10级佣兵，需要付出艰辛的努力和牺牲。您是否考虑过雇佣较低等级的佣兵？

scripts.text:
[Mercenary Manager]
I'm sorry, but your
Loyalty rating is too
low to hire a 10th Grade
Mercenary. You must have
500 or more Loyalty to
form a contract with one.
scripts.translation:
[佣兵管理员]
很抱歉，您的忠诚度太低，无法雇佣10级佣兵。您必须拥有500点或以上的忠诚度才能与其签订契约。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary Manager]
I'm sorry, but you must
be at Base Level 90 or
higher to form a contract
with a 10th Grade Mercenary.
scripts.translation:
[佣兵管理员]
很抱歉，您的基础等级必须达到90级或更高，才能与10级佣兵签订契约。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary Manager]
Congratulations! It looks
like you're planning in taking
on some very dangerous work
since you're hiring a 10th
Grade Mercenary. I wish you
the best of luck with him.
scripts.translation:
[佣兵管理员]
恭喜！看来您打算从事一些非常危险的工作，因为您正在雇佣一名10级佣兵。祝您一切顺利。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary Goods Merchant]
Hello, I sell goods
that Mercenaries can
use. Is there anything
in particular that
you're looking for?
scripts.translation:
[佣兵用品商人]
您好，我出售佣兵可以使用的物品。您有什么特别需要的吗？

scripts.text:
[Mercenary Goods Merchant]
{0}
each cost {1} zeny.
How many would you like?
scripts.translation:
[佣兵用品商人]
{0}每个售价{1} Zeny。
您想要购买多少？

scripts.text:
[Mercenary Goods Merchant]
You changed your mind?
Alright, feel free to come
back to me whenever you want
to buy any Mercenary Potions.
scripts.translation:
[佣兵用品商人]
您改变主意了？
没关系，如果您想购买佣兵药水，随时欢迎回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary Goods Merchant]
I'm sorry, but you
can only buy up to
10,000 of these potions
at a time. Please enter
a number from 1 to 10,000.
scripts.translation:
[佣兵用品商人]
很抱歉，您一次最多只能购买10,000瓶这种药水。请输入1到10,000之间的数字。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary Goods Merchant]
I'm sorry, but you don't
have enough zeny for this
many potions. Well, I'll be
be here when you're ready
to purchase something
for your Mercenaries.
scripts.translation:
[佣兵用品商人]
很抱歉，您的Zeny不足以购买这么多药水。当您准备好为佣兵购买物品时，我会在这里等您。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary Goods Merchant]
If I gave you that many
potions, you wouldn't be
able to carry them with you.
Please come back after
you free up some space
in your Inventory.
scripts.translation:
[佣兵用品商人]
如果我给您这么多药水，您将无法携带它们。
请在清理出一些物品栏空间后再回来。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary Goods Merchant]
Here's your {0}.
Thank you, and please come
again when you need more
potions for your Mercenaries.
scripts.translation:
[佣兵用品商人]
这是您的{0}。
谢谢，当您还需要更多佣兵药水时，请再次光临。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary Goods Merchant]
Here you are, this is exactly
{0}.
Thank you, and please come
again when you need more
potions for your Mercenaries.
scripts.translation:
[佣兵用品商人]
给您，正好是{0}。
谢谢，当您还需要更多佣兵药水时，请再次光临。
